note: Source review found the declared MAX_UTF8_OUTPUT_BYTES cap can be exceeded by recognized_text: text block bytes are summed before joining with newline/space separators, but separator bytes are omitted. For two nonempty blocks totaling exactly the cap, recognized_text is cap+1. QR symbology strings are also not included in the output budget. Add fake-backend boundary regressions and bound final emitted text/QR string payloads before allocation; keep APIs/version/macOS baseline frozen. Existing pure validation and P64 tests pass but do not cover this boundary. Native recognition acceptance is not established by these fake tests.
